name: Taming 3DGS
aliases: High-Quality Radiance Fields with Limited Resources
definition: Explores a spectrum of resource-efficiency trade-offs to enable high-quality rendering on consumer-grade GPUs.
summary: Taming 3DGS is a resource-efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting method that enforces a fixed Gaussian budget to enable high-quality rendering on consumer GPUs with faster training and smaller models.
